## Executive Summary

The DeepL recovery completed with failures. Across the final throttled run, it persisted **5,502** catalog translations; **12** supported English fallback entries remain because their protected syntax markers were not returned intact.

DeepL does not support the project locales `am` and `yo`, leaving **1,246** entries unsubmitted. The account has **707,325** characters remaining. This audit preserves **7,634** one-line API call records, including retries and earlier failed attempts.

The exact unresolved called entries are consolidated in [Rejected Items](#rejected-items) at the end of this report.
